newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on Monday in slightly increased turnover.
A shares rose 1.1 percent to $114.25 from Friday's $113 and B shares rose 0.75 percent to $118 from $117.125.
Turnover increased slighty to 9,244 shares from 9,080 and value was $1,062,633.625 from $1,032,780.625.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None of the shares were traded in the last two weeks.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.26 percent to 84.64 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.74 percent to 986.63.
